digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The carry-forward list closed out today, while Amazon Connect testing and business controls remain the main follow-through for tomorrow. The EPMO Team Meeting was canceled, giving the afternoon a little more room around the remaining sessions.

items.label: Set project coverage while Sara is out
items.detail: The coverage work across Preparers’ Certification, Criminal Research, Knowledge Management, and Biometrics is marked complete.

items.label: Closed the Tuesday attendance conflicts
items.detail: The follow-up on missed or delegated Amazon Connect and EPMO updates is marked complete.

items.label: Moved the NTA automated task through the CoE intake
items.detail: The follow-up on the routed intake and its September 1 timing is marked complete.

items.label: Finalized the change-management staffing setup
items.detail: The process-engineer and PM-allocation follow-up is marked complete.

items.label: Set the permanent Contigo IVR path
items.detail: The owner and delivery-target follow-up for the permanent IVR is marked complete.

items.label: Closed the Incident Response stakeholder follow-through
items.detail: The bucket-owner response and implementation-decision follow-up is marked complete.

items.label: Reviewed the Team Lead Suspensions intake
items.detail: The review of whether the request belongs in the CoE path is marked complete.

items.label: Track the Amazon Connect business-control decisions
items.detail: Confirm the business process and training for Auto Answer, choose an appropriate maximum queue wait time, capture the Auto Answer risk in the RAID log, and assess the two-week AWS timeline impact.

items.label: Keep Amazon Connect UAT progress visible
items.detail: Testing is mandatory. Track daily completion, participant feedback and bugs in a shared location, and carry unresolved access or support questions into Thursday’s training and project sync.

items.label: Resolve the Venn split-tunnel rollout discrepancy
items.detail: Hilary reported that Venn said the configuration had been deployed to all users on August 18, but it had not. Confirm the actual rollout status and the recovery owner.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp Module 2 follow-up survey
items.detail: Byron sent another reminder for the Team Development follow-up survey, which is still awaiting Jean’s response.

items.label: Clear the overdue Rippling task
items.detail: Rippling sent a same-day notice that one firm task remains overdue; review and complete or route it.

items.label: EPMO Team Meeting was canceled
items.detail: The 2:00 PM EPMO Team Meeting appeared on the calendar as canceled.

items.label: Nicolas will serve as PM for Knowledge Management
items.detail: Jean’s meeting note says Nicolas is assigned as the project manager so the work can continue with the right project structure.

items.label: Amazon Connect UAT participation is mandatory
items.detail: Nadia clarified in Teams that the UAT is required and directed participants to Thiago for questions.

items.label: 9:00 AM - SMS Automation Optimization status
items.detail: Review weekly progress, upcoming priorities, resources, risks, and blockers.

items.label: 10:00-11:00 AM - Amazon Connect training overlaps the Knowledge Management and SVC touchpoints
items.detail: Amazon Connect training starts at 10:00 AM. Knowledge Management Project Sync and the SVC standup both begin at 10:30 AM, so decide coverage before the morning stack.

items.label: 11:00 AM-2:30 PM - Project and leadership follow-through
items.detail: Amazon Connect weekly sync starts at 11:00 AM, followed by the BCP/Incident Response weekly meeting at 12:30 PM and the Thiago 1:1 at 2:30 PM.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Amazon Connect UAT overlaps Tudo Bem’s Weekly Meeting
items.detail: The second UAT working session and Tudo Bem’s Weekly Meeting are both scheduled from 4:00 to 5:00 PM; choose live coverage and protect the testing work.
